column1: # The rule engine (src/guj.rs) handles the open class off the stem
# (infinitive minus -વું); this table carries the few verbs whose
# present stem, future or perfective (past) participle is not
# predictable. A `-` group falls through to the rule; the imperfective
# participle and the conditional -ત form stay regular for every verb.
# જવું "go" is suppletive in the past (ગયું) and has the present stem
# જા-; લેવું/દેવું "take/give" have the -ધ- past and the લે-/દે- present;
# ખાવું "eat" is regular except for the -ધ- past; થવું "become" has the
# present stem થા- and the past થયું.
